title: Embassy correspondence: waiting for the Americans to make a statement

tellings.quote: correspondence there's actually a a document that says we're waiting for the Americans to make a statement.

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron, on Jesse Michels's podcast, talks about papers from the personal files of Wilbert Smith, a Canadian government engineer of the 1950s, which also involve Omond Solandt, a senior Canadian defence science official. Cameron says there is correspondence from the Canadian embassy in Washington, including a document stating that they were waiting for the Americans to make a statement. He raises it because it would mean Canada knew something about UFOs and was holding back until the United States went public.
